simple.meaning: מְכַסֶּה (mᵉkaççeh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a covering , i.e. garment ; specifically, a coverlet (for a bed), an awning (from the sun); also the omentum (as covering the intestines).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
